item.title: Letter: Inspired? - HeraldNet.com
item.description: We currently have a leader that uses personal attacks, insults, and name calling when not pleased with someone or their actions. So, it is hardly a surprise to see that he has inspired other Americans to do the same [Herald Tuesday 19 Mar: “Chief Justice decries personal attacks on judges.”]

item.title: Letter: Was our righteous anger distasteful? - HeraldNet.com
item.description: I am writing in response to the letter submitted by Mr. Amburgy regarding the actions outside of Planned Parenthood that he thought were distasteful. Were we shouting? Were we not letting the anti-abortion rhetoric be heard? Were we on the sidewalk expressing our feelings regarding the church and the government controlling our bodies? YES, to all.
